rounds.summary: Found EOF counting ambiguity and editor/output clipboard scope ambiguity; both accepted and confirmed resolved by fresh Round 2 review before synthesis.

findings.summary: EOF line counting is ambiguous across preview and output parsers.
findings.evidence: spec.md permits a final empty document line conditionally; web/src/live-preview.js counts editor lines while web/src/markdown.js uses markdown-it token content. Closed and unclosed one-line fences can have identical token content x plus newline.
findings.resolution: Defined parsed-content counting with zero for empty content, exactly one terminal empty segment removed, explicit closed/unclosed examples, counting-only newline normalization, and matching cross-surface validation.

findings.summary: AC-4 conflates editor Markdown copying and rendered HTML code copying.
findings.evidence: AC-4 requires selected Markdown while AC-7 and web/src/app.js export/print paths use rendered HTML without Markdown fences.
findings.resolution: Scoped AC-4 to editor Markdown selection/editing and AC-7 to rendered HTML copying; clarified output-specific wrapping and print validation.

rounds.summary: Confirmed F-1/F-2 proposed resolutions address prior issues and found no new material blockers; critique converged before synthesis.

finalReview: Synthesized only after fresh Round 2 convergence. Compared final spec with immutable original intent, user-confirmed live-preview/HTML/print scope, both finding dispositions, and inspected parser/rendering/native/test paths. Original intent remains exact and original SHA-256 unchanged. AC-1 through AC-7 each have one concrete executor/method/evidence mapping. Replaced ambiguous EOF behavior with explicit examples; separated editor Markdown copying from rendered output copying; retained parsed nested fence boundaries, source-mode/frontmatter/inline/diagram exclusions, byte-preserving persistence, and output-specific wrapping/pagination. No unresolved product decisions or findings remain. Read-only parser probes support counting assumptions; feature automation, system clipboard, geometry/screenshots, standalone output, and native print pagination remain required implementation evidence, not checks passed by preparation. Existing repository complexity and dependency findings are unrelated to these documentation-only changes.
